Hi Waldo,

Thanks for checking in, and sorry your B30 has taken longer than the mid October date we gave you on September 15.

Here is where it stands. Your Harlo B30 is in batch 1, which has left the factory and is on its way to our US warehouse in Tennessee. Your order ships October 30. The P. Kit and the Miner Duster on the order are already reserved there and go out in the same box as the miner, so it is one parcel and one tracking number, emailed to you as soon as the label prints.

You can follow that incoming batch on our shipment status page here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates there can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but October 30 is the date we are working to.

If anything changes before then, I will write to you here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
